title: Verified art, Blender learning and game-asset references
scope: Project-local reference catalog and planned learning exercises; no personal skill installation or external content mirroring.
verificationMethod: Read primary creator/publisher pages and official documentation; query exact supplied GitHub repository metadata where available. A 404 means unavailable to this check, not proof of historical nonexistence. Search non-results do not establish that a lesson never existed.

verifiedFacts.claim: Free browser references include primitive forms, rotatable anatomy, and dynamically posable body-part models.
Timed drawing offers selectable intervals and browser-local progress backup; the publisher documents lighting controls in its 3D viewer.

license.label: Custom reference-use terms; individual third-party source rights also apply.
license.scope: Drawing studies may be published or sold; raw photographs, model files and site code may not be scraped or repackaged into a competing reference library without permission.
license.redistribution: Link to the service; do not vendor its raw reference collection.

access.signup: No account wall appeared in the retrieved model index or timed-drawing page; an optional newsletter exists. Interactive browser execution was not tested.

resources.name: Blender Manual: asset fundamentals

verifiedFacts.claim: The glTF exporter documents supported animation channels and export modes; its restrictions require a real engine import check. The baking manual covers UV/image targets and normal-map baking.
Mirror configuration depends on origin/axis settings. Skin deformation can be adjusted with vertex-group weights, especially around joints.

license.label: Documentation reference; no manual text or implementation vendored.
license.scope: Follow the actual software/add-on license if code is later copied.

access.signup: No account required for public manual; direct fetches failed, indexed primary excerpts were readable.

claimCorrections.claim: Every Blender material, modifier, constraint or effect automatically survives GLB export.
claimCorrections.correction: Export support varies by data type and exporter version; bake or rebuild unsupported content, then inspect the imported result.

recommendedUse: Use documentation matching the installed Blender version
Validate export rather than inferring engine behavior from the Blender viewport
